description:
All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution. 

 Data Engineer  Summary: Lead data architecture and database operations, ensuring reliable, high-performing, and well-governed data services that support contract writing, reporting, modernization, and enterprise data quality through common data models and structures.

 Required Skills: 

 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Analytics, or a related technical field



 
 Relevant certification(s) in data engineering, cloud platforms, databases, Agile methodologies and CompTIA Security+



 
 4+ Years in data engineering, ETL/ELT, database design/development, data integration, data migration, APIs and data pipelines



 
 Experience designing, developing, and supporting solutions using Oracle Database, Amazon RDS for Oracle, PostgreSQL, AWS data services, ETL/ELT technologies



 
 Active Secret clearance; ability to obtain Top Secret clearance based on Government requirements.



 
 Desired Qualifications: 

 
 Experience managing data supporting Appian environments

 Experience with Oracle environments, data warehouse or business intelligence support, phased data migration, contract-related data, and collaboration with architects, developers, and operational stakeholders in federal mission systems is strongly desired

 Knowledge of data warehousing, reporting feeds, metadata, data lineage, and integration patterns.

 Oracle certification preferred

 
 Responsibilities: 

 
 Develop and maintain ACWS data pipelines, mappings, integrations, and reporting feeds.

 Support data migration, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and quality management.

 Coordinate data requirements with BI, application, architecture, and database teams.

 Document data flows, transformation logic, assumptions, and validation outcomes.

 Recommend improvements to data reliability, automation, analytics readiness, and governance

 
  

 #DSA209 

 #LI-JE1

  
 The posted salary range is a good-faith estimate. Actual compensation will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. 
 

 DSA - Salary Pay Range
 $120,000 — $130,000 USD 


 Many of DSA's positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. DSA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. DSA is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. DSA requires background checks , where permitted , by law. DSA is an E-Verify Employer.
